Usage: a2web serve [OPTIONS]

  Run the a2kit server.

  ``--transport=http`` runs the multiplex parent: MCP under ``/mcp`` and the
  REST surface under ``/api`` (narrow with ``--select``). ``stdio`` (default)
  serves MCP only — a pipe carries one protocol. ``--internal-uds PATH`` adds
  a private spoke listener in parallel, in either transport mode.

Options:
  --transport TEXT               Transport: 'stdio' or 'http'.  [default:
                                 stdio]
  --host TEXT                    HTTP bind host.  [default: 127.0.0.1]
  --port INTEGER                 HTTP bind port.  [default: 8000]
  --code-mode / --no-code-mode   Override the bundled code-execution surface
                                 for this run. --code-mode forces it on, --no-
                                 code-mode forces it off; absolute, not
                                 relative to config. Omit to defer to
                                 config.mcp.code_mode (env
                                 A2KIT_MCP__CODE_MODE), then the built-in
                                 default (on).
  --code-mode-allow-destructive  Let the code-execution sandbox reach
                                 destructive tools.
  --compact                      Drop the structuredContent channel for non-
                                 conformant MCP clients.
  --tools TEXT                   Comma-separated tool name subset to expose on
                                 the MCP surface (e.g. --tools=ask,refresh).
                                 Intersects with the A2KIT_TOOLS env var when
                                 both are set. Cannot re-enable hidden tools.
  --select TEXT                  Narrow the served surface (repeatable).
                                 Syntax 'category=values' (verb|name|surface);
                                 e.g. --select 'surface=mcp' serves MCP alone,
                                 --select 'surface=api' serves the REST
                                 surface alone. Multiple --select flags AND
                                 together.
  --internal-uds TEXT            Path for a co-resident internal spoke: a
                                 private Unix-domain-socket listener (0600)
                                 for first-party jobs to call verbs back into
                                 this process, authed via TokenAuth. Runs in
                                 parallel with the public listener, sharing
                                 one runtime. Off-host unreachable.
  --help                         Show this message and exit.
